items.name: The heart-stone of the Ember Crown
items.text: A red stone the size of a child's fist, cracked through like old ice, with three jagged hollows where the shards were broken out of it. It is warm, but only just, like a hearth the morning after. When you hold it near the shards, they lean toward it.

items.name: Tier pass
items.text: A square of stiff card stamped with the Regency's green seal, letting the bearer up the Stair into the High Tiers. The name on it is not yours, and the ink is not quite dry.

items.name: Masque invitation
items.text: Cream card edged in gold leaf, inviting the bearer to the Lord Regent's Masque at the Ember Palace. A knife has been embossed where a crown should be.

items.name: The Queen's last letter
items.text: A folded sheet in a quick, slanting hand, sealed with a moth in red wax. 'If you are reading this I have gone north, and I am not dead, whatever Varric tells you. Do not come after me. Bring the crown.' It is signed only: I.

items.name: Candied orange peel
items.text: Curls of orange peel boiled in sugar and rolled in more sugar, from the one stall in Highspire that still gets ships from the south. Absurdly expensive for what it is.

items.name: Starlight ink
items.text: A tiny bottle of Collegium ink, black until it dries and then faintly silver, the kind magisters use for star charts. Any wizard would pretend not to want it.

items.name: Frost tonic
items.text: A bitter Collegium cordial that tastes of pine and burnt sugar and sends heat flooding down to your fingertips.

items.name: Knife-Guard rapier
items.text: A slim, well-kept duelling blade with a knife engraved on the guard where the Queen's ember used to be.

items.name: Regency brigandine
items.text: A green velvet coat lined with riveted steel plates, cut to look like court dress at a distance. It does not fool anyone up close, which is rather the point.

items.name: Glass ward
items.text: A round buckler of Collegium glass, clear as water and harder than steel. Faint frost forms on it when something with briar in it comes near.

items.name: Ember signet
items.text: Queen Isolde's own signet, taken off the Regent's hand: a ring of red gold with an ember cut in the bezel. In Highspire, people bow to it before they remember not to.

items.name: Fell's reading glass
items.text: Magister Aldwin Fell's old reading glass on its frayed ribbon, given to you with the words: 'Look closely at everything. Especially the people who tell you not to.'

items.name: Mirela's frost-glass
items.text: A drop of Collegium glass on a fine silver chain, with a single frost-flower caught inside it that never melts. Mirela made it the night she stopped counting. It is always, faintly, warm.

items.name: Coal-yard chit
items.text: A Regency requisition slip for forty sacks of coal, signed by Captain Dunmore, delivery to 'the Stair, by my order'.
